notes: Catalog entries describe upstream sources; binary assets are not copied into the repository in this foundation step.
Prefer CC0 assets for bundled character components.
Check the exact downloaded pack edition and preserve its license file before adding any asset.

sources.name: Quaternius Universal Base Characters
assets: 6 humanoid bases: teen, regular and superhero proportions; male and female
sources.compatibility: Humanoid rig; animation-friendly topology; intended for retargeting
sources.restrictions: The free Standard edition is sufficient for initial testing; verify the downloaded archive's included license.

sources.name: Quaternius Modular Character Outfits - Fantasy
sources.compatibility: Designed to fit Universal Base Characters; humanoid rig
sources.restrictions: Keep the outfit pack's source license and compatibility notes with imported assets.

sources.name: Quaternius Universal Animation Library
sources.compatibility: Universal humanoid rig; retargeting for Godot, Unity and Unreal

sources.name: Sprite Sheet Maker
assets: Blender add-on; pixelation; orthographic and perspective camera; reusable modules
sources.compatibility: Blender add-on; can be used as a separate Blender-side conversion tool
sources.restrictions: Do not copy GPL code into the editor unless the repository's distribution/licensing strategy is intentionally made GPL-compatible. Prefer running it as a separate tool or implement a clean adapter.

sources.name: MPFB / MakeHuman
sources.license: GPL-3.0-or-later-code; bundled assets have separate licenses
sources.compatibility: Blender extension; build-time pipeline rather than browser runtime
sources.restrictions: Audit each asset license separately. The generator code is GPL-3.0-or-later.

sources.name: CharacterCreator (kblood)
sources.license: GPL-3.0-or-later (repository license changed from MIT on 2026-10-03; check LICENSE-NOTES.md)
sources.compatibility: Very close architectural reference for a Blender-to-GLB-to-Three.js bridge
sources.restrictions: Generated output assets have separately documented CC0 provenance; do not copy project source code without reviewing GPL obligations.

sources.name: CharMorph
sources.license: Must be verified from upstream license files before integration
assets: Modular character creation designed for humanoids, animals and other morphologies
sources.restrictions: No code or assets should be copied until the exact source and asset licenses are audited.
